root_cause: Every lane, microtask, probe and export owner gets its own complete cargo target (tree binding: a target is bound to one workspace root, so lane worktrees cannot share one) and nothing retires it when the lane closes; incremental state (288 GiB purged 2026-10-21) regrows with every build; rounds keep a 218 GiB target. About 95 owner dirs exist on D: for 6 active lanes.

policy_changes.change: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 for all builder commands (studio-env.sh) and for rounds/canaries (run-round.sh env_set; steward edit)
policy_changes.effect: removes the largest regrowing class (incremental dirs were 288 GiB on 2026-10-21); workspace crates recompile fully after an edit (seconds to a few minutes per crate)
policy_changes.status: studio-env.sh: applied 2026-10-22; run-round.sh: queued for the steward next sync

policy_changes.change: Lane close-out retires the lane targets: when a lane is PASS (commits on origin) or abandoned, the lead lists <owner>/target(+tmp) on D: and lanes/<owner> on C: in the next deletion batch presented after the round
policy_changes.effect: steady-state footprint = round target + builder slot + at most 6 active lane targets instead of about 95 owner dirs
policy_changes.status: adopted as lead rule; needs Operator approval per batch unless the Operator grants a standing approval for finished-lane targets
